name: Ankh Do
description:
A calm, pharaonic to-do list for the GNOME top bar.

Click the ankh to open your list. Add a task, check it off, and get back to work — without switching apps.

Features
• Drag and drop to reorder tasks
• A stopwatch for every task that keeps running while the menu is closed
• Edit in place, copy, and delete — with undo
• Clear all completed tasks in one step
• Full keyboard control
• A refined night-lapis and gold theme that stays out of your way

Keyboard
↑ / ↓ — move between tasks
Alt + ↑ / ↓ — reorder
Space — mark done
Enter or F2 — edit
T — start or pause the timer
C — copy
Delete — delete
Esc — cancel or close

Privacy
Your tasks are stored locally in ~/.config/scroll-of-deeds/tasks.json and never leave your computer. Ankh Do makes no network requests, and it uses the clipboard only when you copy a task.
